interface.title: MARS-OS: Circadian-Kernel (Mission Biological Drift Monitor)
interface.field: Space chronobiology / circadian physiology, human factors for Mars surface missions
interface.stage_of_work: planning and scenario simulation (what-if modelling before or during a mission)
interface.what_it_is_for: Simulate how a crew's circadian clock drifts sol by sol on Mars (24.6167 h day), and from that compute a cognitive Performance Index, GREEN/YELLOW/RED alert levels and a 480 nm light-therapy prescription, for a chosen mission length, chronotype, wake time and phototherapy correction factor.

data.note: No upload or demo dataset. Everything is computed from the sidebar settings and built-in constants (T_Mars=24.6167 h, Δ=37 min/sol, λ=480 nm, d_crit=6 h). Two CSV exports downloaded: mars_os_sol180_c0pct.csv (full per-sol report, 10 columns: sol, drift_h, drift_min, performance_index, alert_level, light_intervention_required, light_window_start_h/end_h, exposure_min, intensity_lux) and mars_os_timeline.csv (the same columns for 14 sampled sols). A second pair was downloaded after changing settings: mars_os_sol310_c0pct.csv plus a second mars_os_timeline.csv.

tree.general: Predict how circadian misalignment builds up over a long mission and compare light-therapy correction levels
tree.specific: Simulate SCN drift, Performance Index, alert levels and the 480 nm light Rx across a Mars mission under different chronotypes and phototherapy correction factors

features.general: A small read-only box stating the fixed model assumptions behind every computed value
features.specific: Sidebar Constants box: T_Mars = 24.6167 h, Δ = 37 min/sol, λ = 480 nm, d_crit = 6 h
steps: open the sidebar
read the Constants box

screens_never_reached: Direction = DELAY in the prescription panel: unreachable by construction (per the source code read in review, compute_drift clamps drift to ≥ 0 and compute_intervention returns DELAY only when drift < 0); across Standard/Early Bird/Night Owl, 0–100% correction and sols 14–106 it always showed ADVANCE
not_done: The DELAY phase-shift prescription cannot be produced: drift is clamped to ≥ 0 and DELAY requires drift < 0, so no sidebar setting reaches it.

The scenario comparison has only the four fixed scenarios (0/30/60/100%, Standard chronotype, default wake). The user's own settings are not drawn as their own curve in that view, so an arbitrary value such as 45% or a Night Owl run cannot be compared side by side on the plots.
A current sol that is not one of the fixed sampled sols (e.g. 33) does not appear in the timeline table or the timeline CSV.
Changing Duration resets Current sol to 14. I noticed this but did not explore it further.
The charts are static images: no hover readouts, zoom or clicking on data points; only Fullscreen.
Reached Duration 30 and 500 extremes only by reading the slider labels; did not run them.
Sidebar collapse was tried once (screens/033.webp); re-expanding it was not tested.
One click late in the run (trace step 81) timed out; its target is not recorded and its screen was not kept.
Out of scope for the dashboard: the README's Van der Pol SCN simulation (simulate_scn), multi-mission db/schema.sql and CLI are not exposed in this interface.
